subject: marketing
objective: How much credit does each channel get under different attribution rules?
instruction: A business is preparing a marketing & customers analysis. The question is: How much credit does each channel get under different attribution rules. The tile covers Enter the credit each channel receives under first-click, last-click and linear rules and see how much the shares disagree. The declared figures are: channels row 1: name search, first click 420, last click 260, linear 320; row 2: name social, first click 180, last click 310, linear 290; row 3: name email, first click 120, last click 150, linear 110. Use attribution across channels in a competitive market and industry context, and report the method's result.
